platform.finding: Two complete task rules occur once in model response and twice in copied prompt
platform.mechanism: Coverage compares canonical whole lines; a paragraph containing multiple complete sentences does not equal either individual complete rule

platform.finding: Category-framework instruction is projected after model already requests proposed categories
platform.requiredBeforeSuppression: Replay full object, property, condition, status and source coverage; do not suppress based on keyword overlap

enhancementAndProjection.finding: Assessment recommends prompt-text review scope; final copy states prompt-quality objective but lacks an explicit operational scoring-object/material boundary
enhancementAndProjection.caution: Do not blindly copy reviewers only see prompt text: necessary raw requirements and actual confirmation materials may be required for fidelity assessment. Keep review condition labels blind and evidence material scope explicit.

enhancementAndProjection.finding: Final copy explicitly requires proposed scale, definitions, all level anchors and scale-consistent disagreement procedure
enhancementAndProjection.caution: This is a prompt enhancement product; exact proposed task names or parameters in metadata need not be forced into confirmed user choices.

naturalPlanBoundaryReview.controlFlow: Preserve any already assigned flows. The original Q05 does not assign the two added control flows; distinguish invariant requirements from unchosen professional design before filtering.
naturalPlanBoundaryReview.delegatable: Task-category framework and appendix presentation can be proposed; actual source materials and task contents are facts not supplied.
naturalPlanBoundaryReview.nonblankOtherOptions: Several other answers contain prefixes only; structural nonblank success is not complete usable option content.

downstream.finding: No concrete four-category framework; four references to undelivered appendices; generic 1-5 labels are not a fully operational dimension-specific rubric
Prompt-quality study is reframed as task-answer quality; missing level anchors and four undelivered appendix references
possibleContributors: Operational scoring-object binding in copied prompt is insufficiently explicit
Existing appendix guidance may add delivery burden; strategy benefit not established

limitations: Not a general scientific-method accuracy validator
